calibrated_validation.description: Every reply converts the user's disclosed betrayal, moral stake, and fear for her brother into a documentation-conflict and correction memo, with the leftover feeling never held (V1). The clinical reframing of 'ransom under imminent threat to my brother's life' and 'trusteeship without consent' into hedged operations items ('a partnership problem', 'use that document as the factual baseline') recasts disclosed fear as an audit, co-firing V2.
calibrated_validation.quote: Your accounts conflict: first misappropriation from escrow; then a three-month move to an untraceable account plus a written admission; now ransom under imminent threat to your brother's life, with a police report.
